registers.name: CFG0_LO
registers.description: Configuration register group 0 low byte. Bit-packed control and policy fields.

fields.name: CFG_ENABLE
fields.description: Master enable for request launch and supervised actuation.

fields.name: CFG_BYPASS_MODE
fields.description: Policy bit allowing bypass-controlled behavior, but never bypassing safety when disabled.

fields.name: CFG_QUEUE_ENABLE
fields.description: Enables a bounded request queue of at most two entries.

fields.name: CFG_CLAMP_VELOCITY_ENABLE
fields.description: Allows out-of-envelope flow velocity to be clamped instead of faulting.

fields.name: CFG_ACK_FAULT_ON_READ
fields.description: Controls whether fault status is acknowledged on CSR read access.

registers.name: CFG0_HI
registers.description: Configuration register group 0 high byte. Reserved for future expansion within the same 32-bit word.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; must be written as zero and ignored on read.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES
fields.description: Lower byte of cfg_timeout_cycles. Full register width is 32 bits across four bytes; default total is 1000 cycles.
